nome_en: Invincible Operation, Grand General of the Galaxy Falcon Squadron
nome_jp: GF 隊総大将 無敵ング
testo:
■ When your tooltip wins a battle, you may put this creature from your hand into the battle zone.
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, if you have tooltip in the battle zone, choose 3 of your opponent's shields and put them into their owner's graveyard.
